scripts.dev: npm run db:push && tsx watch src/server/index.ts
scripts.db:push: sh -c 'export DATABASE_URL="${DATABASE_URL:-file:../data/homelab.db}" RUST_LOG=debug; prisma db push --skip-generate && prisma generate'
scripts.build: prisma generate && tsc -p tsconfig.server.json && vite build
scripts.test: sh -c 'export NODE_ENV=test DATABASE_URL="file:../data/test-$(date +%s)-$$.db" HOMELAB_VAULT_KEY=test-vault-key-for-homelab-dashboard ADMIN_PASSWORD=test-pass COOKIE_SECRET=test-cookie-secret-with-more-than-32-chars PRISMA_SCHEMA_ENGINE_LOG_LEVEL=trace RUST_LOG=debug; prisma generate && prisma db push --skip-generate && vitest run'
